title.zh: MindForge Guard Labs 实验插件

description.en: Agent claim–evidence review experiments for DeepSeek Harness using synthetic workflow evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合成 AI Agent 主张—证据审阅实验。

description.en: Deterministic review of user-declared synthetic AI-agent claims against structured events, snapshots, authorization, policy and coverage records; returns bounded verdicts with reasons and evidence references.
description.zh: 对用户声明的合成 AI Agent 主张进行确定性审阅，结合事件、状态快照、授权、策略及覆盖记录，输出有限判定、理由和证据引用。
